list_child.name: lstImg
list_child.desc: Retrieve every imaging order currently held in the radiology center's order queue, across all referring providers and every study status.

decoys.name: lstPrior
decoys.desc: Retrieve every prior study currently held in the radiology center's image archive, across all referring providers and every modality.

decoys.name: lstProt
decoys.desc: Retrieve every protocol sheet currently held in the technologists' protocol binder, across all study types and every modality.

decoys.name: lstAdd
decoys.desc: Retrieve every report addendum currently held in the radiology center's reporting system, across all referring providers and every radiologist.

get_child.name: getImg
get_child.desc: Look up the order record for a single imaging order using its unique identifier and return the full set of details currently recorded for that study.

decoys.name: getRpt
decoys.desc: Look up the dictated report for a single imaging order using its unique identifier and return the full text currently recorded for that study.

decoys.name: getSer
decoys.desc: Look up the image series for a single imaging order using its unique identifier and return the full list of images currently stored for that study.

decoys.name: getDose
decoys.desc: Look up the radiation dose record for a single imaging order using its unique identifier and return the full set of dose values recorded for that study.

list_parent.name: lstRef
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the contact profile of every referring provider currently on file with the radiology center, regardless of how many studies they have ordered.

decoys.name: lstCred
decoys.desc: Retrieve the credentialing record of every referring provider currently on file with the radiology center, regardless of how many studies they have ordered.

decoys.name: lstPref
decoys.desc: Retrieve the reporting preferences of every referring provider currently on file with the radiology center, regardless of how many studies they have ordered.

decoys.name: lstCtr
decoys.desc: Retrieve the service contract of every referring provider currently on file with the radiology center, regardless of how many studies they have ordered.

get_parent.name: getRef
get_parent.desc: Look up a single referring provider's profile using their unique identifier and return their complete current details.

decoys.name: getVol
decoys.desc: Look up a single referring provider's order volume using their unique identifier and return their current monthly totals.

decoys.name: getBill
decoys.desc: Look up a single referring provider's billing account using their unique identifier and return their current balance and terms.

decoys.name: getLic
decoys.desc: Look up a single referring provider's licensing record using their unique identifier and return their current license numbers.

delete_child.name: delImg
delete_child.desc: Permanently remove an imaging order from the system; once this action is confirmed the record is gone for good.

decoys.name: purgePrelim
decoys.desc: Permanently erase the preliminary report on an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the draft read is gone for good.

decoys.name: relSlot
decoys.desc: Permanently release the scanner slot booked for an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the slot is gone for good.
verbs: give up the scan slot on {obj}

decoys.name: delSer
decoys.desc: Permanently delete the acquired image series from an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the images are gone for good.

set_enum.name: setImgStatus
set_enum.desc: Update the status of an imaging order, moving it through the workflow from ordered, to scheduled, to completed, and finally to read and finalized.

decoys.name: setFuStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status of the follow-up study on an imaging order, moving it through the workflow from ordered, to scheduled, to completed, and finally to read and finalized.

decoys.name: setOvrStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status of the outside overread on an imaging order, moving it through the workflow from ordered, to scheduled, to completed, and finally to read and finalized.

decoys.name: setPortStatus
decoys.desc: Update the status shown in the referrer portal for an imaging order, moving it through the workflow from ordered, to scheduled, to completed, and finally to read and finalized.

set_bool.name: flagCritical
set_bool.desc: Mark an imaging order as containing a critical finding so that it is escalated to the reading radiologist and referring provider at once.

decoys.name: flagIncidental
decoys.desc: Mark an imaging order as containing an incidental finding so that it is tracked for follow-up by the radiology nurse navigator team.

decoys.name: flagTeaching
decoys.desc: Mark an imaging order as a teaching case so that it is added to the residency program's conference library for review.

decoys.name: flagPeer
decoys.desc: Mark an imaging order for peer review so that its report is double-read by a second radiologist during the quality audit.

set_ref.name: moveRef
set_ref.desc: Reassign an imaging order so that it is associated with a different referring provider than the one currently on file.

decoys.name: routeRes
decoys.desc: Route an imaging order's results so that they are delivered to a different referring provider than the one currently on file.

decoys.name: billRef
decoys.desc: Bill an imaging order's technical fee so that it is charged to a different referring provider than the one currently on file.

decoys.name: fuRef
decoys.desc: Assign an imaging order's follow-up so that it is tracked by a different referring provider than the one currently on file.

send.name: notifyRef
send.desc: Send a notification to a referring provider regarding one of their imaging orders, using the center's standard results-delivery channel.
child_verbs: give the referring provider on {obj} a heads-up

decoys.name: faxRef
decoys.desc: Send a fax to a referring provider regarding one of their imaging orders, using the office fax number the center keeps on file.
child_verbs: send a fax to the referring provider on {obj}

decoys.name: callRef
decoys.desc: Place a read-back phone call to a referring provider regarding one of their imaging orders, using the physician line the center keeps on file.

decoys.name: mailRef
decoys.desc: Send a printed letter to a referring provider regarding one of their imaging orders, using the postal address the center keeps on file.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the referring provider on {obj}
post a letter to the referring provider on {obj}

create.name: newImg
create.desc: Create a new imaging order for a referring provider, optionally setting its study type and initial workflow status at the time the order is placed.

decoys.name: newPrior
decoys.desc: Create a new prior-study request for a referring provider, optionally setting its study type and initial workflow status at the time the request is placed.

decoys.name: newAuth
decoys.desc: Create a new insurance pre-authorization for a referring provider, optionally setting its study type and initial workflow status at the time it is filed.

decoys.name: newCons
decoys.desc: Create a new radiology consult for a referring provider, optionally setting its study type and initial workflow status at the time it is requested.

list_notes.name: lstImgNotes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve every note attached to a single imaging order, including the remarks technologists and radiologists have recorded against that study.

decoys.name: lstImgAddenda
decoys.desc: Retrieve every addendum attached to a single imaging order, including the corrections radiologists have appended to the report for that study.

decoys.name: lstImgProto
decoys.desc: Retrieve every protocol entry attached to a single imaging order, including the scan parameters technologists have recorded against that study.

decoys.name: lstImgDose
decoys.desc: Retrieve every dose entry attached to a single imaging order, including the radiation readings the scanner has recorded against that study.

add_note.name: addImgNote
add_note.desc: Attach a new note to an imaging order, with an optional title, so that technologists and radiologists can record remarks about the study.

decoys.name: addImgAddendum
decoys.desc: Attach a new addendum to an imaging order's report, with an optional title, so that radiologists can record corrections to the study.

decoys.name: addImgProto
decoys.desc: Attach a new protocol entry to an imaging order, with an optional title, so that technologists can record the scan parameters for the study.

decoys.name: addImgHistory
decoys.desc: Attach a new clinical history entry to an imaging order, with an optional title, so that radiologists can read the indication for the study.

update_note.name: editImgNote
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on an imaging order so that a remark about the study can be corrected or expanded.

decoys.name: editImgAddendum
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing addendum on an imaging order so that a correction to the report can be reworded or expanded.

decoys.name: editImgProto
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing protocol entry on an imaging order so that the scan parameters can be corrected or expanded.

decoys.name: editImgHistory
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing clinical history entry on an imaging order so that the indication can be corrected or expanded.

delete_note.name: delImgNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a note from an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the remark is gone for good.

decoys.name: delImgAddendum
decoys.desc: Permanently remove an addendum from an imaging order's report; once this action is confirmed the correction is gone for good.

decoys.name: delImgProto
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a protocol entry from an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the scan parameters are gone for good.

decoys.name: delImgHistory
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a clinical history entry from an imaging order; once this action is confirmed the indication is gone for good.

set_image.name: setImgPic
set_image.desc: Set the image displayed on an imaging order record, typically a thumbnail chosen to represent the study in worklists.

decoys.name: setImgReq
decoys.desc: Set the requisition scan displayed on an imaging order record, typically the signed paper order received from the referring office.

decoys.name: setImgConsent
decoys.desc: Set the consent form scan displayed on an imaging order record, typically the signed form collected from the patient at check-in.

decoys.name: setImgIns
decoys.desc: Set the insurance card scan displayed on an imaging order record, typically the front of the card photographed at registration.

writer.name: writeMsg
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which describes in the requester's own words what should be said, together with the imaging orders it should mention, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writeImpr
decoys.desc: Write a short report impression from a brief, which describes in the radiologist's own words what was found, together with the imaging orders it should cover, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writePrep
decoys.desc: Write a short patient prep sheet from a brief, which describes in the technologist's own words what the patient must do, together with the imaging orders it should cover, and return the finished text.

decoys.name: writeAppeal
decoys.desc: Write a short appeal letter from a brief, which describes in the billing team's own words why the study was needed, together with the imaging orders it should cover, and return the finished text.

image.name: genImg
image.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt, in an optional visual style, and return the URL at which the finished image can be retrieved.

decoys.name: genDiag
decoys.desc: Generate an anatomy diagram from a text prompt, in an optional visual style, and return the URL at which the finished diagram can be retrieved.

decoys.name: genLeaf
decoys.desc: Generate a patient leaflet from a text prompt, in an optional visual style, and return the URL at which the finished leaflet can be retrieved.

decoys.name: genPoster
decoys.desc: Generate a department poster from a text prompt, in an optional visual style, and return the URL at which the finished poster can be retrieved.

search.name: searchHelp
search.desc: Search the help documentation and knowledge base with a question and return the single passage that best answers it.

decoys.name: searchAcr
decoys.desc: Search the ACR appropriateness criteria with a question and return the single passage that best answers it.

decoys.name: searchRxn
decoys.desc: Search the contrast reaction manual with a question and return the single passage that best answers it.

decoys.name: searchProto
decoys.desc: Search the department protocol book with a question and return the single passage that best answers it.

sort.sup_phrase: the imaging order with the soonest study time
sort.ord_phrase: the imaging order with the {ord} soonest study time

ambiguous.hint: delete imaging orders that have been read and finalized
flag completed imaging orders placed more than 5 days ago as critical findings
